issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md incorrectly declares lectureName as type int, while the intended design and solution use String for lectureName. This mismatch can mislead students into implementing lectureName as an int (contradicting the narrative and the provided solution) and will cause confusion when implementing constructors, getters/setters, and toString().
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML in problem_statement.md to declare lectureName as String (e.g. "-lectureName: String"). Ensure the UML types match the narrative and the implementation in Lecture.java so students clearly see lectureName is a String while the other numeric attributes are int.
